annotations.title: Estimate federal estate tax and check state estate taxes

description: Estimate U.S. federal estate tax for the current year and whether the person's state estate or inheritance tax may apply, including how much a charitable gift in the will saves. Federal tax is 40% of the taxable estate above the exemption ($15 million per person in 2026). For married couples it assumes everything passes to the spouse first and estimates tax at the second death with both exemptions. State results flag thresholds and top rates rather than computing state tax. General information, not tax advice.

charitable_gift.description: Dollar amount left to charity at death (optional).

estate_value.description: Total value in USD of everything the person owns, including home, investments, retirement accounts and life insurance they own, minus debts.

lifetime_taxable_gifts.description: Total taxable gifts made during life above the annual exclusion (optional).

married.description: True if married to a U.S. citizen.

state.description: U.S. state (or DC) of residence: full name or two-letter code.
